description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget called ReviewCard used to display a review summary including average rating, number of reviews, star distribution, and visual star ratings. It contains the ReviewCard widget and a nested RateBar widget for visualizing star ratings with progress bars.

classes.name: ReviewCard
classes.description: A widget displaying a review summary with numerical ratings and star visualization.

classes.name: RateBar
classes.description: A widget representing a horizontal bar visualizing the proportion of reviews with a certain star rating.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the ReviewCard widget's UI, including rating display, star visualization, and review distribution bars.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the RateBar widget's UI, including a label for star count and a progress indicator for review proportion.
